title: Deliverable 638799: Spend Requests in Base App
summary: Spend Requests allow users to create requisitions for planned expenses and link them to journal entries and purchase documents for automatic updates during posting.
key_points: New Spend Request tables, pages, enums and a document report track requests to spend money
General journal lines and purchase documents can reference a spend request number, which updates the request on posting
General journal check, posting and reversal logic, plus purchase posting, were extended for spend request links
The feature is delivered early so the Expense Agent team can build Travel Requisitions on it
Still incomplete: approvals, an amount check at posting and a report layout are missing
